entities.summary: Vadassery Damodaran Satheesan is an Indian lawyer and politician who has served as the 11th Leader of the Opposition in the Kerala Legislative Assembly since 2021. A member of the Indian National Congress, he has represented Paravur Assembly constituency since 2001.
